note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All texts, provisions, levels, values and readings are fictional placeholders; jurisdiction unspecified. The before/after link states are supplied by the author and only drive the clip; no instrument is shown to be valid, lawful or binding.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The link tag's value changes from 'Authorization supplied' to 'Authorization to be checked'; with the supplied after-state the clip opens and is laid beside the enabling page, the cord goes slack and the passage keeps only a pencil outline.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the reverse substitution with different fictional texts — the tag goes from 'To be checked against Rule 7' to 'Rulebook 2 copy supplied', and with the supplied after-state the open clip is clamped onto the enabling page; the detail window sits on the right.
